title: Propagation phenomena in KPP-bistable periodic patchy environments
summary: This paper first investigates the propagation dynamics of solutions to the Cauchy problem for a one-dimensional reaction-diffusion equation in a spatially periodic environment consisting of two distinct patch types. The novelty of this work lies in the systematic analysis of a KPP-bistable heterogeneous framework. In this setting, the respective patch lengths, the linear stability of the zero solution and the positive periodic steady state, and the magnitude of the initial data play crucial roles in the long-time dynamics.
